meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清理代码中AI生成的坏味道与冗余痕迹
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常担心AI助手留下的代码不够干净
copy.tagline_en: Clean up AI-generated code smells and redundant patterns in your recent changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often worry about messy code left by AI assistants

howto.what: 它会先为改动文件补上回归测试锁住现有行为,再按九类 AI 代码异味(多余注释、过度防御、死代码等)分批清理,最后跑测试与静态检查;验证不通过就回退。
howto.when: 当你要求清理、deslop 或去除最近改动里的 AI 代码异味时触发;不传参数时默认处理分支相对 merge-base main 的 diff,也可直接给出文件列表。

say.text: 清理我这次分支改动里的 AI 代码异味
say.note: 先跑回归测试锁定行为,再分批清理。

say.text: 帮我把 src/foo.py 和 src/bar.py 去一下 slop
say.note: 按你给的文件列表处理。

say.text: 看看我的改动里有没有超过 250 行的文件并拆分
say.note: 发现超长文件会先给拆分方案。

howto.what_en: Locks behavior with regression tests first, then cleans nine categories of AI code smells (redundant comments, over-defensive code, dead code, etc.) in batches, and runs tests plus static checks; failed verification reverts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes. Defaults to the branch diff against merge-base main; a file list can be given instead.

say_en.text: Clean up the AI slop in my branch changes
say_en.note: Locks behavior with tests, then cleans in batches.
Runs on the files you list.

say_en.text: Find files over 250 lines in my changes and split them
